title: Bloomberg Economics' Becca Wasser and Dina Esfandiary Talk Iran Conflict
gist: Podcast teaser: Becca Wasser and Dina Esfandiary discuss the Iran war ahead of Trump's UNGA meetings with Gulf leaders; the war has cost the US over $43 billion per the Pentagon, with Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia and rising energy prices.
